items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: And they had a guy named Sawyer... And he's all with Buddy now. Yeah these were with Arthur Durbin. This was a different band. Oh Arthur Durbin. Arthur Durbin's band. Did you play with Arthur Durbin's band? [INTERVIEWER] Yeah.

ctx.x: And we had a guy who played bass Eddie.

His name was Eddie from Ovin L.G. And then we had a fellow playing Simmons, he played Clannett with Arthur Durbin. Where was your name? And I remember him. And I remember him. And we had a guy who played bass Eddie. His name was Eddie from Ovin L.G. And then we had a fellow playing Simmons, he played Clannett with Arthur Durbin. Where was he from? Over in Al Jays. Simeon? Yeah. Simeon? Yeah. That's his name, a little short, a little short, a little short, very fair, yeah. He was a Creole guy, he was short, very…
Yeah. So they would never bring it?
